label: Finding-74
title: gov-patch-required: 1 smaller precision and sourcing point
description: Status 'reported' understates a statement carried by NSA's own release; the wording should keep it NSA's: The claim drops 'are serious enough to' and, read without its 'by' line, sounds like a mandate. Suggested: 'NSA says the risks are serious enough to require immediate patching across US Government departments and agencies' with status confirmed (that NSA said it).
